prompts.marcelo:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete hand-painted walking animation sprite atlas for the existing Street Vicente Fighter game. Input image 1: the APPROVED exact character reference. Preserve his face, hair, body shape, costume, colors and painted illustration style exactly. Use the man in the reference, not another fighter.
Create a transparent RGBA atlas with EXACTLY 8 complete full-body frames arranged in 4 columns and 2 rows, evenly spaced cells, no labels, no grids, no backgrounds, no shadows/effects. Keep each figure fully inside its cell with 8% padding. EVERY frame is the SAME person and consistent scale, head height and outfit, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT with fists held in fighting guard. A real smooth short-step arcade fighting walk: alternating legs, anatomically connected hips and knees, ankle flexion, both legs visible, no rubber limbs, no detached clothing, no dragging feet. Exact row-major cycle: 0 right foot forward planted/left foot behind heel lifted; 1 transfer weight to right foot, left knee bends and left foot lifts; 2 left foot passes beneath hips with bent knee while right foot stays planted; 3 left leg extends forward heel descending; 4 left foot forward planted/right foot behind heel lifted; 5 transfer weight to left foot, right knee bends and right foot lifts; 6 right foot passes beneath hips bent while left planted; 7 right leg extends forward heel descending to loop into 0. Keep guarded head/shoulders stable, subtle 2% body bob, realistic pelvis shift. Feet baseline at 94% height of every cell; complete original painted torso and complete legs in EVERY frame. Both legs remain attached to the pelvis with natural fabric folds. NO component parts, NO skeleton pieces, NO morphing of face/body between frames, NO extra limbs, no big steps or lunges. A polished coherent 8-frame game animation, same detailed arcade cartoon style as the supplied approved fighter sheet.
